encoding: Mandate Core v1 canonical encoding, keccak-256 (docs/adr/0020-mandate-core-package-and-encoding.md)
note: Integers are decimal strings; the validators accept exactly that form. `canonical` is the tagged top-level encoding; `digest` is keccak-256 of it.

vectors.description: A semantic module: name, version and manifest digest.
The next version: a new version and a new digest.
Same name and version as v2, different digest: a different semantic module (DOM-2).
An enforcement adapter bound by digest.
600.000000 USDG of capital, funding asset USDG.
600.000000 USDG of margin: same number and unit as the capital vector, different kind and identity.
+0.03 BTC position size, exposure to canonical BTC.
−0.01 BTC: a signed kind, encoded as int256.
4,000.00 USD committed notional valued at an order's limit price, sourced from the action.
2,997.00 USD committed notional valued at the fill price, sourced from an observation.
19,000.00 USD marked gross exposure: an invariant value at an admitted mark, never a ledger counter.
−35.000000 USDG realized PnL: signed, no asset, no valuation.
3 actions.
A global BTC notional dimension, a global marked-exposure invariant and a global mark-price state policy.
The explicitly empty policy: roots are independent, by the principal's statement.
A root grant (Core mandate) carrying all seven term kinds.
A delegation: parent by AuthorityId, issued by the parent's holder.
A perp order envelope: no perp field in it; the payload is a module-bound digest.
A spot buy envelope: the same Core fields as the perp order.
A venue mark-price observation at a venue sequence.
An account snapshot with a source-declared validUntil.
A mark-price binding: AGE 5 s, RECHECK at issue, enforced at execution by the limit price.
An account binding: SEQUENCE freshness, WITHIN_POLICY, pre-trade only.
A binding whose artifact must expire with the state (AGE + BOUNDED_BY_FRESHNESS).
Generation 1 of the sample action.
Generation 2 of the same action: a different reservation.
An authorization of generation 1 with the state binding it relied on.
The adapter's binding of execution parameters to that authorization.
A decision receipt header that wrote ledger version 58.
Every lifecycle object a receipt names, by digest.

derivations.description: One payload under module v1: the module digest is inside the hash.
One payload under module v2: the module digest is inside the hash.

negative.description: The sample action with its last byte removed.
The sample action with one extra zero byte.
A principal policy decoded as a grant: domain separation.
The sample action with schema version 2.
Resources out of canonical order: refused, not re-sorted.
A presence flag of 2: only 0 and 1 decode.
A term-kind wire code that does not exist.
A principal policy carrying an OPEN_RISK right: it grants nothing.
A reservation ref at generation 0: no reservation has generation 0.
A ModuleRef whose digest is the all-zero placeholder.
A binding at trust class UNTRUSTED: never admissible.
BOUNDED_BY_FRESHNESS with SEQUENCE freshness: sequence distance has no expiry time.
